fault.moveCopyLeft: The event is still in both calendars
fault.moveUnresolved: The move could not be confirmed. Check both calendars
fault.moveDestinationUnavailable: The other calendar is no longer available
fault.notAllowed: The calendar does not let this change be written.
fault.gone: The event is no longer in that calendar.
fault.unreachable: The calendar could not be reached.
fault.notKept: The calendar would not keep this change as written.
fault.versionUnknown: The calendar's copy could not be read, so nothing was sent.
fault.earlier: An earlier change to this event was not saved, so this one was not sent.
fault.chained: Press again once the change before it is done.
fault.expired: This change waited too long and was not sent.

refusal.changed: The event has changed. Open it again to see the latest version.
refusal.off: The calendar is off for this account.
refusal.readOnly: This calendar can be looked at, not changed.
refusal.full: Too many changes are waiting. Try again in a moment.
refusal.left: It is being sent now. It can be let go once the calendar has answered.
refusal.connection: This calendar's connection is waiting for you in Settings.
refusal.invalid: This change could not be read as written.
refusal.gone: This event is no longer here.
refusal.tooLarge: This change is too large to send.
refusal.replay: This press was already sent with other contents.
